h1: Cabinet Painting in West Houston, TX
bodyHtml:
West Houston kitchens — in Memorial, the Energy Corridor, Briargrove, and Walnut Bend — often feature custom cabinetry and millwork worth preserving rather than replacing. A precise sprayed repaint updates the look, protects the wood, and keeps the craftsmanship, all for a fraction of new cabinetry. It is detailed work, and detail is what The Proud Paintbrush does.

We spray a hard, furniture-grade finish over genuine prep — degrease, sand, and bonding primer — for a result that reads custom up close.

West Houston Cabinets Deserve a Careful Hand

Many Memorial and Briargrove homes have solid-wood cabinets, raised-panel doors, and built-ins from the 1980s–2000s — exactly the cabinetry that rewards a meticulous spray finish over a rushed brush job. We mask and protect surrounding stone, hardwood, and high-end finishes, and we take the time these higher-value kitchens require.

Our Cabinet Painting Process

  • Label & remove — doors, drawers, and hardware tracked for an exact refit.
  • Degrease & sand — grease cut, surfaces scuffed, profiles hand-sanded.
  • Bonding primer — grips slick or previously finished surfaces; no chipping.
  • Spray, cure & reinstall — sprayed enamel cured between coats, refit and adjusted.

Why West Houston Homeowners Choose Us

We treat higher-value kitchens with the care they require, protect every surrounding finish, and back the work with our written warranty — locally owned and insured. See the full cabinet painting process, add a kitchen repaint, view cabinet pricing, or request a free estimate.

faqs.q: Do you paint custom cabinets and built-ins in Memorial?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom cabinetry, raised-panel doors, and built-ins are some of our favorite West Houston projects — they reward a careful, sprayed finish.

faqs.q: Will you protect my hardwood floors and stone counters?
faqs.a: Always. We mask and protect floors, countertops, backsplashes, and surrounding finishes before any prep or spraying begins.

faqs.q: Can you match a specific designer color?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match nearly any color and sheen, and we'll advise on durable cabinet finishes that hold up to daily use.
